title: SwiftUI kit on macOS: gate
summary: The gate on macOS, drawn as a labelled fixture of DJDL in both presets: Welcome at the default, narrow, short and large window, inline license activation, Finish in your browser (no QR) and the device limit's browser hand-off, plus the one line the integrator writes.
compare: The product is the hero: DJDL's icon leads every step, its accent comes from the icon (kits are not service-accented), no Polaris Key mark appears, and the name is said once (the title).

DL1 on a window: two panes from 560px of window, a one-line strip below; the end pane is top-aligned; the short landscape window drops the lede and links instead of scrolling; the large window is one capped card on a flat ground.

Under polaris-key the start pane is the product art and the head carries the icon; under native it is the icon alone on the quiet ground and the head carries none, with the host's tint, fields and button style.
Inline is the default presentation (D-79) for activation and sign-in; the dialog form is the labelled alternative and is not drawn.
No QR on a desktop surface (DL14): the browser hand-off shows the code, Copy, the countdown and Open browser again with the external-action glyph.
DL6: the device limit on the key path is a neutral callout under the heading, and its fix is the one primary, Open in browser, with the external-action glyph (the key path has no in-app removal).
One primary per state; the key middle-elides at rest and its end is visible; weights 400/500/600; hairlines only; no static accent line under the title bar.
The host draws the window chrome (dots, caption buttons or header bar); the kit draws none.
macOS: Cancel directly left of the default; sentence-case catalog copy; capsule controls at 28pt, 13pt body, 22pt titles.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots, mockup mode)
designReview.verdict: Good after one fix round: no QR on a desktop surface, every refusal neutral, one primary per frame; the clipped visionOS panel, copy drift between boards and screens, mixed accents on the polaris-key cards and weak polaris focus rings were fixed.

findings.issue: Copy for the same step differed between the boards and these screens (sign-in wording, Back and Cancel on inline steps, offline action, expired code).
findings.resolution: One wording everywhere: the sign-in step reads 'Check the code there matches this one.' with 'Or go to <url>'; inline steps say Back, only sheets say Cancel; the offline action is Try again; the expired code uses the catalog sentence.

findings.issue: The visionOS panel clipped Cancel on sign-in and device limit.
Vertical centring of the TV and desktop columns.
findings.resolution: declined: DL1 top-aligns the panes with the panel's content.
